Build a canonical exploreDE .h5ad from user-supplied data

Source: R/build_explore_h5ad.R
build_explore_h5ad.Rd

The source-agnostic "bring your own data" constructor. x is either a DESeqDataSet (the preferred starting point: its counts, colData, rowData and factors are used) or the counts themselves (a matrix, or a named list of matrices such as list(counts=, normalised=, vst=, tpm=)). From a SummarizedExperiment, pass its assays as such a list, with coldata = colData(se) and rowdata = rowData(se). DE tables and pathway statistics are supplied as arguments. Only counts + coldata + omics are required.

Usage

build_explore_h5ad(
  x,
  out,
  omics,
  feature_level = NULL,
  coldata = NULL,
  rowdata = NULL,
  de = list(),
  de_columns = NULL,
  rowdata_columns = NULL,
  pathways = list(),
  enrichment_padj_max = 0.1,
  factors = NULL,
  organism = NA_character_,
  ref_build = NA_character_
)

Arguments

x

A DESeqDataSet, a counts matrix, or a named list of count matrices.

out

Output .h5ad path.

omics

Required: "rnaseq", "proteomics", or "crispr".

feature_level

Optional override of the feature granularity within the omics — rnaseq "gene"/"isoform", proteomics "protein"/"peptide"/"phospho". Omit to auto-detect from rowdata (site -> phospho, peptide_Id -> peptide, transcript_id -> isoform).

coldata

Sample metadata data.frame. Required unless x is a rich object that carries it.

rowdata

Optional per-feature annotation (feature names/symbols/ids and per-feature pathway annotation columns, e.g. GO BP).

de

Optional named list of DE tables keyed by contrast (DESeqResults / data.frame). Name each contrast <test>_vs_<reference>, with both groups levels of one coldata factor (an error otherwise). Columns are recognised by the column dictionary (inst/dictionaries/column_patterns.json), overridable with de_columns. An optional extra score column (e.g. SAINTexpress's SaintScore) is picked up by the dictionary alone and shown for display under its own column name.

de_columns

Optional DE column overrides: list(effect_log2fc = "<col>", score_pvalue = "<col>", score_fdr = "<col>"), applied to all contrasts, or a named list of such lists keyed by contrast. Named columns are used as given; any not named are still found by the dictionary. A producer with no raw p-value (e.g. SAINTexpress) simply has none; the app degrades to FDR-only. Unknown keys are ignored with a warning. Overrides are persisted at uns$exploreDE$mapping$de, so the file stays self-describing.

rowdata_columns

Optional feature column overrides: list(id_col = "<col>", symbol_col = "<col>") — which rowdata column supplies the feature id and the display symbol. Anything not named is still found by the dictionary. Unknown keys are ignored with a warning. Overrides are persisted at uns$exploreDE$mapping$feature.

pathways

Optional pathway statistics: a named list keyed by contrast (keys a subset of de); each entry a named list of clusterProfiler objects and/or data.frames.

enrichment_padj_max

p.adjust cut-off applied to clusterProfiler results before they are stored (p.adjust <= enrichment_padj_max). Either one number for every method, or a named list keyed by the method names used in pathways (e.g. list(ora = 0.05, gsea = 0.05)) so that ORA and GSEA can follow their own FDR thresholds; a method not named in the list uses the largest value given. The value(s) are recorded in uns$enrichment_filter and the app uses a per-method value as its significance threshold.

factors

Optional colData columns that are experimental factors (default: all character/factor-typed columns).

organism, ref_build

Optional labels.

Value

The output path, invisibly.

Examples

library(SummarizedExperiment)
# A prolfqua proteomics result: one contrast, nested in rowData
se <- readRDS(system.file("examples/proteomics/SummarizedExperiment.rds", package = "exploreDE"))
de <- as.data.frame(rowData(se)$constrast_B_vs_A)
path <- build_explore_h5ad(
  x = list(raw = assay(se, "rawData"), transformed = assay(se, "transformedData")),
  out = tempfile(fileext = ".h5ad"),
  omics = "proteomics",
  coldata = colData(se),
  rowdata = de,
  factors = "G_",
  de = list(B_vs_A = de)
)
file.exists(path)
#> [1] TRUE

# Counts only
counts_only <- build_explore_h5ad(
  assay(se, "rawData"),
  out = tempfile(fileext = ".h5ad"),
  omics = "proteomics",
  coldata = colData(se)
)
